resources.string: Each game is prepared if it needs it, then started for 3 minutes with a scripted pad (Start, then A), and graded: prepares, boots, renders, responsive, sustained. The report holds no game data: title ID, name, XDK, engines, stage and the first blocker. Leave the device on this screen, plugged in.
No game to check: choose a library folder or a game first.
Not charging: a check takes hours, plug the device in.
Not charging. Press again to start anyway.
Press Stop again to end the check. The results so far stay in the report.
Keep the device on this screen: the check starts each game from here.
The check is running. Stop it to leave, or Pause.
Share report sends compat-results.jsonl: one line per game, no game data.
Paused: come back to this screen and it carries on
Paused: the device is too hot, it carries on once it cools down
Paused: battery low, plug the device in
